== Title ==
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーン・ユーティリティ・ベルト</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">１フォース使用し、任意の反乱軍かエイリアンに配備する。タトゥイーンにいる間、そのキャラクターの戦闘力と没収値に＋２。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">サバイバル用の装備、食料、道具が細かく区分けされ収まっている。バンサの革製で、ルークや他のタトゥイーンの住人たちが使っている。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Tatooine Utility Belt]].

'''Lore''' — Survival equipment, food, and tools are stored in small divided compartments. It is made of bantha hide and used by Luke and other Tatooine inhabitants.

'''Game text''' — Use 1 Force to deploy on any Rebel or alien. While that character is on Tatooine, that character's power and forfeit are +2.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Printed subtype is アイテム. Game text uses タトゥイーンにいる間 (while present on Tatooine) rather than “While on Tatooine”. White border, 1997 copyright.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-tatooineutilitybelt.gif|Original English face]], [[Tatooine Utility Belt]].</ref>
